content: Firawna ñaakɗiɗ Israayel ca
Wa ɓaa hee pule Etam, Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne :
« Woya Israayel ci ne ɓa welaat, ɓa yip ɗiip ciŋ ɓa ŋ sero Pi-Ayrot, ŋ harmban Migdol na cookma. Yipaat ɗiip ciŋ ɗu ndaam, yurhiɗkoh na Ba'al-Sefon ŋ sero cookma.
Firawna hey woye ne : “ Israayel ci muuƴiɗ ŋ bilaf fa ; kehƴa hulanga rangiɗ ɓa. ”
Ŋ hey ndengɗe keeñiŋ ɗe po a taambiɗ ɗu. Teemb ndeem, ŋ hey teeɓohe yaki ŋ yak, ŋ in ci ŋ tuman ɗe, a yi na hiñohoh ciŋ ɗe, te ɓi Misra hey inhe ne ñam Nikiɗi. » Israayel ca tumohha in ceem jen ɗaa.

Wa Firawna woyu ne Israayel ca saandohiɗ, a yi na ɓooɓaŋ ɗe ɓoƴsohha liiɓohaaɗ ŋ ini kaɗ ngaŋ Israayel ca. Ɓa woosa ne : « Ɓoo haɓiɗ ye cii ? Wa ye tah ɓoo faɗee Israayel ci ɓa cootee, ɓoo raakissuu ñaam ci na hee ɓoo pangkiɗisse ? »
Firawna nakohha tokɗiɗu wotiiraŋ ɗe, a hunnda na hiñohoh caŋ ɗe,
a ɓayya wotiir caŋ Misra jen po ca teemet-yasna-yinooca (600) uupee baah nga ; waa nu nga ɗah, ɓayya hiñohoh kaahay.
Nikiɗi ndengiɗta keeñiŋ Firawna, buuraŋ Misra. Yeem taambiɗta Israayel ca, raak ɓeem puleeɗa na ndeng fit.

Hiñohoh caŋ Misra jen taambiɗta ɓa, ɓum tiindeeɗa, ɓinooɓi rappa panis, ɓi tas aassa ŋ wotiir caŋ Firawna, ɓa ñaakɗeeɗa ɓa po ɓa rahsohha ɓa ŋ sero Pi-Ayrot, yurhiɗkoh na Ba'al-Sefon, ɗiska ɓa yipee ɗiip caŋ ɓa ŋ sero cookma.
Wa Firawna kaɗ po a heeɗa rahse Israayel ca, ɓeem marakka, hotta ne ɓi Misra ɓii hay nga ɓa. Ɓa neƴƴohha lool, ɓa leehkeeɗa naafu ŋ Nikiɗi.
Ɓa woosa Musaa ne : « Misra raakɗi raakɗi ruy-ruy po fu ɓayya ɓoo ŋ bilaf fii ne ɓoo kaanoh nga e ? Fu haɓiɗ ɓoo ye cii, wee tah fu kooɗohha ɓoo Misra ?
Inii weɗ ɓoo woyee ɗa wa ɓoo nik ŋ kur ka haa e ? Ne “ Faɗa ɓoo moɗoɗ, ɓoo nik ñaam ciŋ ɓi Misra. ” Weɗ ngisoh kaan ŋ bilaf fii. »
Musaa loffa ɓa ne : « Kinaat neƴƴoh, tufkaat ɗu marak findi Nikiɗi mucɗohan ɗu woti. Ɓi Misra ɓi ɗu na hote ɓii, ɗu hotissanɗi ɓa muk.
Yeeɓkaat rek. Nikiɗi a yi na hee ɗu hiñohɗe. »
Taambaŋ Israayel ci ŋ ɗooƴ cookma
Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne : « Wa ye tah fu leehkee nga so ? Woya Israayel ci ɓa deguk ŋ waasi.
Ɓaya ndooɗiŋ ɗa ŋ yaah, fu yurhiɗa ŋ cookmi. Fu paysoh cookmi kanak, Israayel ci min taamb nga te kot ciŋ ɗu iiri'uu.
Ini kaɗ nga so, ŋ hey ndengɗe keeñ ciŋ ɓi Misra po ɓa taambiɗ ɗu ŋ ɗooƴ cookmi. Teemb ndeem, ŋ hey teeɓohe yaki ŋ yak, ŋ in ci ŋ tuman Firawna na hiñohoh ciŋ ɗe na wotiir ciŋ ɗe na ɓooɓi rap panis.
Ŋ hey teeɓohe yaki ŋ yak ŋ in ci ŋ tuman ɓa, ɓi Misra inah ne ñam Nikiɗi. »
Ƴutta, malaakaaniŋ Kooh, yi meeɗ adug ŋ fiki Israayel ca, kaɗta ŋ finhooɓa, eela yipee haa kumbin ŋ fikiiɓa nammba kaɗ ŋ finhooɓa.
Wa nikka ŋ harmban dal ca kanak ca, dalaŋ Misra na waŋ Israayel. Eelaam nikka ñuus ŋ ɓaka winoora, waaye weka reesa, wa ñiiniɗta ɓaka tas ne cuuɓ ca kanak ca minuu reɓɗukoh na wek.
Wa Musaa raɗis ndooɗaŋ ɗe ŋ ɗafuk cookma, Nikiɗi neehha puuɗis ŋ pulohaaɗ-noh, puuɗis raakiɗ hatil. A paysohha cookma kanak, merhey mi suyɗi nikka ŋ harmbana.
Israayel ca taammba nga te ɓa iiriiɗi, raak masma ɗingkiɗ findi miir ŋ yaah-ñaahum na yaah-sing.
Ɓi Misra ñaakɗeeɗa ɓa na panis caŋ ɓa na wotiir caŋ ɓa jen ŋ ɗooƴ cookma.
Na wiisaaɗiina, Nikiɗi, yi nikee ŋ ɗooƴ kumbinaŋ yongkaaha na eela, marakka ŋ dalaŋ ɓi Misra, a saɓsohha ɓa na sagoocaŋ ɓa.
A tummba po panuucaŋ wotiir caŋ ɓa minisɗi kaɗ kaɗ yurhiɗ, ineem tahha po ɓa minisɗi nupiɗ baahiɗ. Ɓa woosa ne : « Ɓoo saandohaat, Nikiɗi yii hiñohiɗ Israayel ci. »
Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne : « Raɗsa ndooɗiŋ ɗa ŋ cookmi ne masmi dokkis findi wa nikohe, wa on ɓi Misra, wotiir ci na ɓi rap panis ci. »
Musaa tumohha ineem ɗaa. Ŋ wiisaaɗiina, cookma dokukka findi wa mande, ɓi Misra saandoheeɗa, ɓa cohha na masma, Nikiɗi julla ɓa ŋ ɗooƴ cookma.
Masma dokukka, wa onnda wotiir caŋ Firawna na ɓooɓa rapee panis ca jen. Hiñohoh ca dabee Israayel ca jen tassa ŋ cookma ; ali ɓo' pulɗi nga.
Waaye Israayel ca taambeen ŋ cookma te ɓa iiriiɗi, raak masma ɗingkiɗ findi miir ŋ yaah-sing na yaah-ñaahum.
Mbaɗi, Nikiɗi muciɗta ɓa ŋ yaah ciŋ ɓi Misra. Ɓa hotta fiɗaaf caŋ ɓi Misra ŋ sereendaŋ cookma.
Israayel ca hotta hatili Nikiɗi mucɗoh ɓa nga ɓi Misra, ɓa neƴƴohha ɗe, ɓa kossa Nikiɗi na Musaa ñaamiŋ ɗe.
